description: Java class defining MQTT transport context for Thingsboard, managing connection counters, SSL, and rate limiting.

classes.name: MqttTransportContext
classes.description: Manages MQTT transport connections, SSL, rate limiting, and metrics within Thingsboard.

methods.name: channelRegistered
methods.description: Increments active connection counters based on SSL status.

methods.name: channelUnregistered
methods.description: Decrements active connection counters based on SSL status.

methods.name: checkAddress
methods.description: Checks if an address is rate-limited.

methods.name: onAuthSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful authentication for rate limiting.

methods.name: onAuthFailure
methods.description: Handles failed authentication for rate limiting.
